item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 9 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 9 #VISPRSD
Issued at 11:03 PM 14 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #SouthernLeyte(Sogod), #Cebu(Catmon, Tuburan, CityOfNaga, SanFernando, Pinamungajan, Asturias), #Capiz(Pilar, PresidentRoxas, Pontevedra, Panay, Panitan, MaAyon, Dumarao, Cuartero), #Iloilo(Lemery, Sara, Ajuy, BarotacViejo, SanRafael), #Antique(Sebaste, Culasi, Tibiao and Barbaza) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #SouthernLeyte(Silago), #Cebu(Sogod), #Iloilo(Carles, Balasan, Estancia, Batad, SanDionisio, Concepcion), #Capiz(Tapaz, Jamindan), #Aklan(Libacao, Madalag, Malinao, Banga and Balete) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
